text_description: Full-length runway look centered on a loose, knee-length shirt dress in a pale grey-green wash with an allover faded newspaper/collage-style graphic print, including scattered black rectangular motifs and text-like markings. The dress has an open pointed collar forming a V neckline, relaxed dropped shoulders, and roomy sleeves rolled to just below the elbows, giving a softened utilitarian shirt silhouette. A dense cascade of raw-edged, layered ruffles frames the collar and runs diagonally down the front opening, continuing into an irregular ruffled hem that falls around the knees with an asymmetrical, deconstructed finish. The waist is lightly gathered or tied at the side/front with visible fabric tabs and hanging ruffled strips, keeping the fit relaxed rather than sharply cinched. Styling includes a chunky gold necklace at the base of the neck, gold drop earrings, and a structured dark handbag carried low in one hand, with short handles and metal ring/chain hardware. Bare legs are visible below the dress; footwear is not clearly shown. The overall mood is eclectic, distressed, and romantic-utility, combining washed graphic fabric, oversized shirting proportions, and dramatic frilled texture.
